Screen reader test: Superstore_Product_East

Expected text (open after listening, to compare)

Alt text (140 characters): Superstore Product Drilldown, East region: monthly sales heatmap by category for 2022-2025, and a sales and profit dot plot by sub-category.

Summary: Product Drilldown dashboard filtered to the East region. Top chart: a heatmap of sales by product category (Furniture, Office Supplies, Technology), year (2022 to 2025) and month. Monthly sales range from $84 (Office Supplies, February 2022) to $22,940 (Technology, October 2025). Sales tend to be highest in September, November and December, and Technology in October and November 2025 ($22,940 and $22,584) are the two largest months. Furniture has no sales shown for February 2022. Bottom chart: a dot plot of sales per product, grouped by sub-category and split by customer segment (Consumer, Corporate, Home Office), with dots colored by profit ratio from -50% (red) to 50% (gray). Most products sell under $5,000. The largest outliers are a Copiers product near $20,000 in Consumer, a Machines product near $14,000 in Corporate, and a Copiers product near $11,000 in Home Office. Unprofitable red dots cluster in Tables and Bookcases across all segments and in Machines for Consumer and Corporate.
